title: MRFlow: Mechanism-Structured Residual Flow Matching for Virtual Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.13966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting cellular responses to chemical and genetic perturbations is a central test for AI virtual cells, yet many single-cell models reduce each condition to an average expression shift. This target is misaligned with perturbation biology: rare states, resistant subpopulations, and context-dependent effect sizes may coexist under the same intervention. MRFlow treats virtual-cell prediction as conditional transport between empirical single-cell measures. Control and perturbed cells are embedded in a variational latent state space, greedy low-cost supervision is constructed over detached minibatch states, and a conditional flow-matching vector field transports control populations toward perturbed populations. translated_title: MRFlow：面向虚拟细胞扰动预测的机制结构化残差流匹配
translated_abstract: 预测细胞对化学和遗传扰动的响应是AI虚拟细胞的一项核心考验，然而许多单细胞模型将每种条件简化为平均表达变化。这一目标与扰动生物学并不相符：在相同的干预下，稀有状态、耐药亚群以及依赖于具体情境的效应强度可能同时存在。MRFlow将虚拟细胞预测视为经验单细胞度量之间的条件传输问题。对照细胞与扰动细胞被嵌入到一个变分潜在状态空间中，在分离的小批量状态上构建贪婪的低成本监督，并通过条件流匹配向量场将对照细胞群体传输至扰动细胞群体。该向量场分解为一个机制结构化的仿射字典（将共享的潜在响应算子与低秩的条件特异性修正进行重组），以及一个谱受控的残差场，用于刻画非线性的细胞级（响应）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MRFlow将虚拟细胞的扰动预测建模为单细胞群体间的条件流传输，通过机制结构化仿射字典与谱受控残差场的组合，超越平均表达变化，捕捉稀有状态和耐药亚群等异质性细胞响应。
en_tdlr: MRFlow formulates virtual-cell perturbation prediction as conditional flow transport between single-cell populations, using a mechanism-structured affine dictionary and a spectrally controlled residual field to capture heterogeneous responses such as rare states and resistant subpopulations beyond average expression shifts.
